image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally on a bed of smooth, rounded river stones. The crab displays a broad, oval carapace with mottled brown and grey coloration that provides camouflage against the rocky background. Its two large chelipeds (claws) are prominent in the foreground, showing dark tips and lighter joints. Several walking legs are visible extending laterally, tucked among the stones.
